title: A Note on Personal Style
excerpt: A little test of what longer writing on Cusp of Cancer might look like.

content.text: Personal style is less about constantly finding something new and more about learning what feels like you. The pieces we return to, the combinations we repeat, and the things we wear until they become part of our daily lives.
This is a second paragraph. Eventually, this space can hold longer essays, observations, travel writing, photographs, and commissioned stories.
